title: Skardu & Deosai
summary: Six days from Lahore to Skardu over Babusar Top: Shangrila, Upper Kachura Lake, the cold desert and a full day on the Deosai plains.

image.alt: A clear stream winding across the green Deosai plateau towards snow-streaked mountains

overview.headline: Six days to Skardu, its lakes and the high Deosai plains
paragraphs: We cross Babusar Top to Skardu and spend three nights there. One day is for the lakes: Upper Kachura, the calm of Shangrila, and the cold desert where sand dunes meet the mountains.
The other is a full day by jeep on the Deosai plains, one of the highest plateaus in the world, with Sheosar Lake, wildflowers in summer and, if we are lucky, marmots.
suitedTo: Travellers who have seen Hunza and want Baltistan next
Families with older children who are fine with long drives
notSuitedTo: Serious heart or breathing conditions: Deosai is above 4,000 metres
Anyone who dislikes long road days: days 2 and 5 are 11 hours or more
Very young children, for the altitude and the jeep day

itinerary.title: Lahore → Naran
itinerary.text: North on the motorway, then up the Kaghan valley to Naran.

itinerary.title: Naran → Skardu
itinerary.text: Over Babusar Top, down to the Indus at Chilas, then east on the Skardu Road, high above the gorge.

itinerary.title: Shangrila and the cold desert
itinerary.text: Upper Kachura Lake and Shangrila in the morning, the sand dunes at Katpana in the afternoon light.

itinerary.title: Deosai Plains
itinerary.text: A full day by jeep on the plateau: Sheosar Lake, wildflowers and, with luck, marmots.

itinerary.title: Skardu → Naran
itinerary.text: Back along the Skardu Road and over Babusar Top to Naran.

itinerary.title: Naran → Lahore
itinerary.text: Down the Kaghan valley and home on the motorway by evening.
